products.title: Mini Pineapple Latte Stone Cookies
products.body_html:
Mini Latte Stone Cookies are crispy, bite-sized shortbread cookies made right here on Guam. These Pineapple Mini Lattes bring a slightly sweet and tropical twist to everyday snacking and midnight munchies. Eat them by the handful or try them in your next trifle, parfait, or chia pudding!

ミニ ラッテ ストーン クッキーは、グアムで作られた、サクサクとした一口サイズのショートブレッド・クッキーです。このパイナップルミニラッテは、毎日のおやつやちょっと小腹のすいた夜食に、ほんのり甘くてトロピカルな風味を齎してくれます。手づかみで食べたり、トライフルやパフェ、チアプディングなどに入れてお召し上がりください！

products.title: 1000pc Puzzle, Artist Collection No. 1 (Love of Land and Sea)
products.body_html:
This Love of Land and Sea Puzzle features artwork from Guam-based artist, Lee San Nicolas (IG: @thefueking), and is the first in a series of Artist Collection Puzzles and Keepsakes from Everything Guam, LLC.

This 1,000 piece puzzle showcases a picturesque underwater scene with a gliding green sea turtle and sea life in the foreground and Guam's iconic Two Lover's Point in the background.

Puzzle Dimensions (when completed): 18.8 x 26.7in / 48 x 68cm
Outer Box Dimensions: 10.63 x 8.66 x 1.97in / 27 x 22 x 5cm

Packaging Type: Shrink wrapped corrugated drawer box, puzzle pieces held inside zipper canvas bag
